ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: There are two long straight wires a and b placed parallel to each other, and as shown in the figure this is a cross-sectional view perpendicular to the wires. In the plane shown in the figure, point O is the midpoint of the line connecting the two wires, and M and N are two points near the two wires; they are on the perpendicular bisector of the line connecting the two wires and are at equal distances from point O. If constant currents I of equal magnitude and the same direction flow in the two wires, then among the statements about the magnetic induction intensity at each point on line segment MN, the correct one is (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The magnetic induction intensities at point M and point N are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a cross section perpendicular to two long straight wires. Wire a is above and wire b is below; the two are located on the same vertical dashed line. Both wire symbols are circles with dots inside, indicating that the current directions are the same and both are perpendicular to the paper surface outward. Point O is at the midpoint of the line connecting a and b. M and N are located on the horizontal dashed line passing through O, namely on the perpendicular bisector of the line connecting the two wires, with M on the left side of O and N on the right side of O, and the two are at equal distances from O. Reasoning: The magnitude of the magnetic induction intensity produced by a long straight current at a distance r from the wire is B=μ0I/(2πr), and the direction is determined by the right-hand screw rule. Since M and N are left-right symmetric with respect to the vertical line connecting the two wires, the distances from M to wires a and b are respectively equal to the corresponding distances from N to wires a and b, so the corresponding component magnetic fields are equal in magnitude. For a current represented by a circle with a dot, the magnetic field direction is counterclockwise around the wire: at point M, the horizontal components of the magnetic fields produced by wires a and b cancel each other, and the vertical components combine in the same direction; at point N the same is true, but the resultant direction is opposite to that at point M. Therefore, the resultant magnetic induction intensities at points M and N are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读取几何关系：截面图中两根导线a、b位于同一条竖直虚线的上下两侧，导线符号均为圆圈中带点，表示两电流方向相同；O在两导线连线的中点，M、N位于经过O的水平虚线即两导线连线的中垂线上，且关于O左右对称。再结合题干文字确认两导线为长直平行导线，电流大小相等、方向相同，M、N到O距离相等。用长直电流磁场公式B=μ0I/(2πr)和右手螺旋定则分别判断每根导线在M、N处产生的磁场：由于M、N关于两导线整体对称，M点到a、b的距离分别等于N点到a、b的对应距离，所以各分磁场大小对应相等；但按右手定则，左右对称点处的合磁场方向相反。因此合磁感应强度满足：M点和N点大小相等、方向相反。
